description: Repository hosting Claude Code skills for RS School mentors plus reference curriculum and student configs. Each entry below is a skill (or other shipped artifact) in this repo, not a sub-feature inside a skill — per-skill internal scope is tracked in commit messages.

features.name: Pocket Mentor — student PR review
features.description: Claude Code skill that runs inside a cloned student repository: bash checkers (init.sh, check-ts-usage, check-no-console, check-git-quality, check-commented-code) + LLM analysis grounded in clean-code/*, optionally guided by a task rubric loaded via --context. Output: CODE_REVIEW_REPORT.md (local), inline PR comments (--output inline), or GitHub issues (--output issues). Stack detection: HTML/CSS, Vanilla JS, TypeScript, React+TS. Angular guard.
features.evidence: Three live smoke runs on student fun-chat PR (2026-05-19/20). Commits v0.9.1..v0.9.6 ship iterative fixes. v1.0.0..v1.0.2 add severity system, Mode A format, anti-repetition, self-check, stack detection, Agent-First protocol, per-stack mandatory reference citation. v1.0.3 (2026-05-27) adds turn-scoped model lock (model: claude-sonnet-4-6) after a 5-model comparison test (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Kimi K2, a GPT model, free-tier baseline) on the fun-chat project showed that weaker models fabricate facts (wrong branch, wrong Conventional-Commits compliance) and miss structural rubric violations.
features.next: Watch list for v1.0.4+: (1) rubric-violation-as-Critical severity escalation — v1.0.2 fun-chat run had magic numbers → 🔴 which may be correct per 'blocks pass' or an over-correction from the pad-findings rule; needs a 2nd observation on a project where rubric violation is the only failing class. (2) Opus 4.7 tendency to place findings only in the Score table without a standalone Mode A finding (observed in v1.0.3 5-model test: routing absence went into Score but not into the Critical issues section on Opus, while Sonnet surfaced it correctly). If pattern persists across 2+ further Opus runs, tighten the Strict rules to require a standalone Mode A finding for every non-zero Score-table deduction.

features.name: Student Reviewer — GitHub Actions
features.description: GitHub Actions workflow that automatically reviews student PRs using clean-code references. Stack detection (HTML/CSS/JS/TS/React). GitHub Models default (zero-friction, uses GITHUB_TOKEN). Override via AI_BASE_URL + AI_API_KEY + AI_MODEL for any OpenAI-compatible provider. Posts line-specific inline comments with suggestions via Octokit.
features.evidence: End-to-end tested on fun-chat student PR with Anthropic Sonnet 4.6. v1.0.0: base implementation — stack detection, GitHub Models default, OpenAI-compatible provider override, inline PR comments. v1.1.0 (2026-05-28): reads RS School task README from PR description URL and passes as <task_requirements> to the AI — enables catching missing features (routing, empty body, explicit types). Graceful fallback to general review when no URL found.
features.next: v1.2: support configurable task URL patterns beyond rolling-scopes-school/tasks so other schools/orgs can use the action.
